visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women stand on a red carpeted stage. The woman on the left, wearing a white sleeveless dress with a high slit and long dark hair, begins playing a silver flute. The woman on the right, also in a white sleeveless gown, holds a violin and starts bowing. They are positioned in front of red velvet curtains decorated with black spider webs and a witch hat hanging above. (2) As they perform, they gently sway their bodies to the rhythm of the music. The lighting is warm and indoor, coming from chandeliers and ceiling lights. To the left of the stage, a black amplifier, a music stand, and various equipment cables are visible on the floor. Yellow captions appear at the bottom of the screen. (3) The performers maintain a serene and focused facial expression throughout the performance. The camera angle is an eye-level wide shot that captures their full bodies and the festive stage environment. The background shows an arched entrance and traditional indoor architecture of what appears to be a hall or event venue.
